category_title: Elementary students with ASD and language delay who generalize virtual experiences to real-world social interactions
scenario_title: Mouse Control and Navigation Confusion in Early Virtual Lessons
minimal_context: The student is using a computer mouse to click on virtual objects in a simulated health center to complete their learning missions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please use the computer mouse to click on the OK bandage in the virtual health center.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Clicks here and there all over the screen) How many questions are left to answer?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We still have a few more. Just try to click on the bandage.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops moving the mouse and stares at an English system pop-up message) What is this? Is this part of the learning material?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can ignore that message. Go ahead and click the bandage.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Unable to smoothly control the mouse to target the small OK bandage, repeatedly missing the trigger area) I can't do it. I am confused about what to do.
